text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People from Germany connected to the 
Satono family have visited Japan. They 
wanted to experience the events at a 
Japanese racecourse, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Satono Diamond and Kitasan 
Black, who had volunteered to help, I 
arrived at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Delicious food stalls and an exciting 
stage... Alright, I'll show you around as 
much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm counting on you, Kita-chan♪
choice_data_list:
It might not be much, but I'll help out 
too!

It might not be much, but I'll help out 
too!

text_block_list.name: German Man
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me! Are you by any chance... the 
young lady of the Satono family...?!"

text_block_list.name: German Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, my interpreter took ill... Ah, 
excuse me. Do you understand German, by 
chance?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh!? Could these people be...? U-Uhm, 
what are they saying?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the interpreter couldn't make 
it. ...Erlauben Sie mir, Ihnen eine kleine 
Tour zu geben.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
!?!?!? D-Dia-chan, what was that just 
now...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just a little. I will step in to 
interpret. Let's guide them around the 
Japanese event as planned!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like the band is about to hold a 
concert. They play everything from marches 
to anime songs, you know?"

text_block_list.name: German Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that so? I'm really looking 
forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible, Dia-chan! To think you 
could carry on a proper conversation like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the truth is, I put extra effort 
into studying foreign languages.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because one day, I want to experience 
races all around the world for myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
For example, the Satono family is 
currently developing an 'Overseas 
Expedition Simulation' software for the VR 
Umalator... but it's still not complete.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to perfectly recreate races from 
around the world and contribute to 
Japanese racing. Because as an Umamusume 
of the Satono family, that is my duty.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's also so that I myself can 
take on the world's races."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Dia-chan's dream... is truly, truly 
big... and strong. The world, huh—)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(...In that case, I want to take a step 
forward too.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Even someone like me can make people 
around the world smile—!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right, Dia-chan! We have that stage event 
everyone's taking part in coming up soon, 
don't we?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
For all the people who came from 
overseas... I want to show them how to 
enjoy the festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! I'll lead by example, so let's 
have fun together—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's hold a "Everyone Together, 
Yo-Yoi-no-Yoi♪ Tracel Ondo Festival"!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Please follow my lead! Let's, together!"

text_block_list.name: German Man
text_block_list.text: "U-Um, raise both hands... Like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Don't worry even if you make 
a mistake! It gets exciting because 
everyone's hearts become one... That's 
what a festival is all about!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Messy-wessy, messy-wessy♪ Heave-ho, 
heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yo-yoi no yoi to the Tracen Ondo♪

text_block_list.name: German Woman
text_block_list.text:
"I see...! I'm starting to get it little 
by little!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's the way! Let's all party it 
up together!

text_block_list.name: German Man
text_block_list.text:
"So this is a Japanese festival...! 
Nom-nom-nom-nom♪"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, we danced so much! ...I hope everyone 
in Germany enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's thanks to Kita-chan, isn't 
it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...No, the only reason I was able to take 
that first step was because I had a best 
friend chasing her dreams."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So I'm the one who should be thanking you. 
...Thank you, Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan.
choice_data_list:
Those two might captivate the whole world 
someday!

Those two might captivate the whole world 
someday, you know!
So you're someone precious to me.
You're someone precious to me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan.
choice_data_list:
Those two might captivate the whole world 
someday!

Those two might captivate the whole world 
someday, you know!
So you're someone precious to me.
You're someone precious to me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right! For example... Running 
overseas together, the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We'll set the whole world on fire with our 
running... and turn it into one huge 
festival!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. With you and me 
together, Kita-chan, we could take on the 
world—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the evening sky, the two best 
friends laughed together, dreaming of the 
world beyond.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! After all, I can't even imagine a 
"me" without Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Both the memories and the things dear to 
me. They're all because Dia-chan was 
there—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep seeing brand-new sights 
together with you!"
